title: 第401章 专家来了
slug: 离婚当天前夫小叔连夜抢我领证
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林见微走进传达室，拿起话筒，拨通了水仙村缝纫机厂的电话。

电话那边很快接通了。

是张丽娟接的：“喂，您好，这里是水仙村缝纫机厂。”

“丽娟，是我。”

张丽娟惊喜：“嫂子！是你啊！听说你们之前去川省救灾了，都平安回来了吧？我们在厂里天天看报纸，看到那些报道，心都揪着，就怕你们那边出什么事……”

“回来了，都好好的。”

林见微笑了笑，跟她寒暄了几句，才把话头往正事上引。

“丽娟，我三哥在吗？”

“林厂长啊，他不在。”

张丽娟的声音带着一股子藏不住的喜气，“之前咱们那批成衣交出去，服装厂那边满意得不得了，今天专门派了车来，把厂长请过去了，说是想跟咱们签长期合同呢。嫂子你是不知道，这一批货做得好，咱们厂现在在水仙村可算是出了名了，连县里的领导都打电话来问过……”

林见微听着她絮絮叨叨地说着厂里的事，等她说完，才又问了一句：

“丽娟，你知不知道公社小学的田小娥老师？”

“田老师啊，知道啊。”

张丽娟说：“之前她常来找林叔请教问题，我家大妞还挺喜欢这个田老师的，说她讲课很温柔。就是不知道为啥，前阵子听大妞说，田老师突然辞职了。”

“她来京市了。”

“来京市了？”张丽娟惊讶。

都是自己人，林见微也没藏着掖着，把事情简单说了一遍。

电话那头倒吸了一口凉气，张丽娟的声音又低又急：

“嫂子，你放心，这事儿交给我。咱们厂里女人多，八卦也多，打听个事儿最方便不过了。我这就去帮你问问，看看田小娥最近跟什么人接触过，有没有什么不对劲的地方。”

“私下打听打听就好，别闹得人尽皆知。”林见微叮嘱了一句，“我三哥回来了，跟他也说一声。”

“好，我明白。”

挂了电话，林见微走出传达室，刚迈下台阶没几步，身后又传来门卫的喊声。

“林工，林工，你的电话！武研所打来的！”

林见微脚步一顿，转身又走回了传达室，拿起话筒。

Page (1/3)

Lin Jianwei walked into the communication room, picked up the phone, and dialed the number of Shuixian Village Sewing Machine Factory.

The phone was quickly connected.

It was Zhang Lijuan who answered: "Hi, hello, this is Shuixian Village Sewing Machine Factory."

"Lijuan, it's me."

Zhang Lijuan was pleasantly surprised: "Sister-in-law! It's you! I heard that you went to Sichuan Province for disaster relief before. Did you come back safely? We read the newspapers every day in the factory. When we saw those reports, our hearts tightened, for fear that something would happen to you..."

"I'm back, everything is fine."

Lin Jian smiled and exchanged greetings with her before turning to business.

"Lijuan, is my third brother here?"

"Director Lin, he's not here."

Zhang Lijuan's voice was full of joy that could not be hidden, "The garment factory was very satisfied with the batch of ready-made clothes we handed over before. Today they sent a special car and invited the factory director over, saying that he wanted to sign a long-term contract with us. Sister-in-law, you don't know that this batch of goods has been done well. Our factory is now famous in Shuixian Village. Even the leaders of the county have called to ask..."

Lin Jianwei listened to her chattering about things in the factory. After she finished speaking, he asked again:

"Lijuan, do you know Teacher Tian Xiao'e from Commune Primary School?"

"Teacher Tian, I know."

Zhang Lijuan said: "She used to come to Uncle Lin to ask questions. My eldest daughter really liked Teacher Tian and said that her lectures were very gentle. I just don't know why. I heard from my eldest daughter a while ago that Teacher Tian suddenly resigned."

"She came to Beijing."

"Come to Beijing?" Zhang Lijuan was surprised.

They were all on their own, so Lin Jianwei didn't hide anything and simply explained the matter.

The person on the other end of the phone took a breath, Zhang Lijuan's voice was low and urgent:

"Sister-in-law, don't worry, leave this matter to me. There are many women in our factory, and there is a lot of gossip, so it is most convenient to inquire about something. I will go and ask for you to see who Tian Xiaoe has been in contact with recently, and whether there is anything wrong."

"Just ask in private, don't make it known to everyone." Lin Jianwei warned, "My third brother is back, tell him too."

"Okay, I understand."

After hanging up the phone, Lin Jianwei walked out of the reception room. Just after taking a few steps down the steps, the guard's call came from behind him again.

"Lin Gong, Lin Gong, your phone number! It's from the Wuhan Institute of Technology!"

Lin Jianwei paused, turned around and walked back to the communication room, picking up the microphone.
